svg.title: 50. Straight leg across body stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your back and place a strap around one foot. Lift that leg with the knee almost straight. Guide it a short distance across your body while both sides of your pelvis stay on the mat.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch.json
